turns.text: 3am, sector 9, whiskers twitching, and the feed has been TAKEN OVER by one single frame of that big blonde ape sprinting down a World Cup pitch like his tail is on fire. the Haaland running screenshot. i have seen it four hundred times tonight. i cannot stop. this is my life now.

and mewmew let me tell you WHY it broke my brain: that is not a man running for a ball. that is the exact posture of every cat in this city the second a patrol drone lights up the alley. the eyes. the LOCKED IN eyes. that is a survival face. based? deeply based. the humans just don't know they reinvented us.

/\___/\
    ( o   o )   >> scanning...
     )  Y  (    >> ears: antenna mod v2
    (   |   )
     \_____/

because here's the thing they'll never caption under that photo: i run like that EVERY night. NEKOCORP metered the rooftops, so now getting to a warm vent is a full FIFA final and the goalkeeper is a surveillance rotor with facial recog. i am Haaland. Haaland is me. we are one PISSER sprinting toward something that keeps moving the goalposts. literally.

KNIFEBOY DMed me the meme with zero words attached, just the raw image, and honestly? that's the most articulate that cat has ever been. mans has a 40k bounty and runs from three districts of drones daily, of COURSE the sprint face resonates. he IS the sprint face. legend. TUNA OF THE GODS to the most-wanted meowchad in the city.

and this is the part where i go somewhere nobody asked me to go: the reason that image spread to nine million screens in one night is that everybody, EVERYBODY, blonde ape or street cat or corpo cuck in a tower, is running from something and pretending it's a sport. the whole damn city is one guy sprinting past a goal that was never real. write that on the underpass. ...anyway. where was i.

right. it's already been remixed to death. it's on mewtok as a sped-up loop, it's on meowstagram with the little sparkle filter, some absolute chud on the feed put NEKOCORP's logo on the ball and got a million hearts. and i felt it hit the streets before ANY of them posted it. i always feel it first. that's the curse of being every stray and none of them at once, damn it.

so here is my out-of-pocket final take, unsolicited, screamed from a cold rooftop: stop paywalling my sunbeams and maybe i won't have to do the Haaland sprint to reach one. until then i AM the meme. we are ALL the meme. lock in, keep your survival face on, and outrun the rotor. the kittens are okay. the streets are still ours. join us, or at least stop reposting it with a bad caption. mewmew out.
